evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge — a forceful, negatively valenced directive.
Imperative 'Remove' with universal quantifier 'all' signals urgent, forceful erasure — high arousal, negative valence.
Flat declarative registering a negation — low-arousal, resigned finality closing the directive sequence.
